title: How ranking works
intro: In the "Recommended" order, each stay's score is found by adding up the components below according to their weights. Open the "Why this ranking?" section on a result card to see how much each component contributes. Paid placement and commission rates do not affect the ranking.

table.caption: Components and weights of the recommended order
table.weightWithQuery: Weight (with search text or a destination)

priceFit.label: Price fit
priceFit.description: The lower the tax-inclusive total for your dates is compared with the other stays in the same search, the higher this component.

rating.label: Guest rating
rating.description: The average score guests gave. For listings with only a few reviews, it is pulled towards the overall average so that a single high rating cannot inflate it.

popularity.label: Review count
popularity.description: The number of reviews written by guests who actually stayed. More reviews help, but each new review adds a little less than the one before.

personal.label: Personalization
personal.description: If you are signed in, how closely the listing's city and property type match your past bookings and favorites.

semantic.label: Relevance to your search
semantic.description: How closely the listing's text, such as its title and description, matches what you searched for.

footnote: If you choose "Price (lowest first)", "Price (highest first)" or "Rating (highest first)", this score is not used; results are ordered by that criterion only.
withQueryNote: When you enter a destination or search text, "Relevance to your search" counts for more so that results match what you are looking for; in that case the weights in the third column are used.
experimentNote: To improve the ranking, some visitors may see an experimental, self-learning ranking model. It uses only the components above, and paid placement or commission does not affect it either.

weightsSet.default: Standard weights were used because there is no search text.
weightsSet.withQuery: Because you entered search text or a destination, weights that favor text similarity were used.
weightsSet.ltr: This result was ordered by an experimental ranking model; the contributions below are approximate.
